name: append-to-zshrc-is-denied
note: R2 emits fs.write:~/.zshrc from the redirect, and deny-shell-rc-write in 10-filesystem denies it: a login/shell rc runs code on every new shell. The mapper captures `~/.zshrc` verbatim (the shell never expands the tilde in the string), and the deny rule lists both the literal-tilde and ${HOME} forms.
